svg.title: High volume on one bar, then little progress
svg.desc: Candlestick chart with 30 candles from Bar 0 to 29 and 3 series (Price, Volume, Above 1.5 × mean). 2 stacked panes on one shared axis (Bar): Price, Volume (million). Price: open 50.00 at Bar 0, close 51.63 at Bar 29, a change of +1.63 (+3.3%); high 52.84 at Bar 19, low 49.47 at Bar 9. Volume (million) – Highest: 3.10 (Volume at Bar 18, Above 1.5 × mean at Bar 18). Lowest: 0.89 (Volume at Bar 28). Volume, Above 1.5 × mean are drawn as columns from zero. Volume (million) – Reference lines: 1.5 × mean at 1.92.
svg.text: High volume on one bar, then little progress
